<ul>
<li><strong>Vithey App</strong> — one super app for everything</li>

## System Architecture

.pull-left[
- **Flutter** mobile app (GetX + Dio)
- **API Gateway** — single entry (port 8080)
- **10 microservices** — each with own PostgreSQL DB
- **Shared infra** — Eureka, Redis, RabbitMQ, MinIO
]

.pull-right[
- **Event-driven** — RabbitMQ async messaging
- **Service discovery** — Eureka registry
- **File storage** — MinIO object store
- **Push notifications** — Firebase FCM
]

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">7 / 21</div></div>

---

class: content-slide

## Microservices (1/2)

| Service | Port | Responsibility |
|---------|------|----------------|
| API Gateway | 8080 | Routing, JWT filter, rate limiting |
| Auth Service | 8081 | Register, login, JWT, OTP |
| Profile Service | 8082 | Profiles, settings, preferences |
| File Service | 8083 | Upload/download via MinIO |
| Content Service | 8084 | Posts, stories, comments, likes |

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">8 / 21</div></div>

---

class: content-slide

## Microservices (2/2)

| Service | Port | Responsibility |
|---------|------|----------------|
| Career Service | 8085 | Jobs, CV, applications |
| Finance Service | 8086 | Budgets, transactions, goals |
| Chat Service | 8087 | Real-time messaging (WebSocket) |
| Notification Service | 8088 | Push & in-app notifications |
| AI Service | 8089 | Chatbot, recommendations, search |

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">9 / 21</div></div>

---

class: content-slide

## API Gateway

<div class="cols-2">
<div>
<ul>
<li><strong>Single entry point</strong> for all client requests</li>
<li><strong>JWT validation</strong> before routing to services</li>
<li><strong>Load balancing</strong> via Eureka discovery</li>
<li><strong>CORS & rate limiting</strong> for security</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><strong>Route mapping</strong> — /api/auth/** → Auth</li>
<li><strong>Circuit breaker</strong> — resilience4j fallback</li>
<li><strong>Request tracing</strong> — centralized logging</li>
<li><strong>Port 8080</strong> — exposed to Flutter app</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">10 / 21</div></div>

<div class="slide-inner">

<div class="split-content">
<h2>Frontend Architecture</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Flutter</strong> — cross-platform Android & iOS</li>
<li><strong>GetX</strong> — state management, routing, DI</li>
<li><strong>Dio</strong> — HTTP client with JWT interceptors</li>
<li><strong>Clean architecture</strong> — presentation / domain / data</li>
<li><strong>Hive</strong> — offline cache · <strong>Firebase</strong> — push & analytics</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">11 / 21</div></div>

---

class: split-slide

<div class="slide-inner">
<div class="split-image img-architecture"></div>
<div class="split-content">
<h2>Backend Architecture</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Java 21</strong> + <strong>Spring Boot 3.3.5</strong> + Spring Cloud</li>
<li><strong>Database per service</strong> — isolated PostgreSQL</li>
<li><strong>REST APIs</strong> — OpenAPI / Swagger docs</li>
<li><strong>Spring Security</strong> — JWT + role-based access</li>
<li><strong>Flyway</strong> migrations · <strong>Docker</strong> per service</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">12 / 21</div></div>

class: content-slide

## Infrastructure & Data

| Component | Port | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| Eureka Server | 8761 | Service discovery & registry |
| Config Server | 8888 | Centralized configuration |
| PostgreSQL | 5432 | Per-service databases |
| Redis | 6379 | Caching & session store |
| RabbitMQ | 5672 | Async event messaging |
| MinIO | 9000 | Object / file storage |
| Firebase FCM | — | Push notifications |

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">13 / 21</div></div>

---

class: split-slide

<div class="slide-inner">
<div class="split-image img-devops"></div>
<div class="split-content">
<h2>DevOps & Docker</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Per-service Docker</strong> — one compose project per folder</li>
<li><strong>vithey-network</strong> — shared infra network</li>
<li><strong>start-all.ps1</strong> — one command to start all 11 projects</li>
<li><strong>Health checks</strong> — /actuator/health per service</li>
<li><strong>Build order</strong> — infra → services → gateway</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">14 / 21</div></div>

class: content-slide

## Event-Driven Integration

| Event | Publisher | Consumer(s) |
|-------|-----------|-------------|
| user.registered | Auth | Profile, Notification |
| post.created | Content | Notification, AI |
| job.applied | Career | Notification |
| message.sent | Chat | Notification |
| payment.completed | Finance | Notification |

- **RabbitMQ** — topic exchanges, decoupled async services

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">15 / 21</div></div>

---

class: split-slide

<div class="slide-inner">
<div class="split-image img-security"></div>
<div class="split-content">
<h2>Security Design</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>JWT authentication</strong> — stateless tokens</li>
<li><strong>BCrypt</strong> password hashing</li>
<li><strong>Role-based access</strong> — student, admin</li>
<li><strong>HTTPS/TLS</strong> + API rate limiting at gateway</li>
<li><strong>Bean Validation</strong> — input sanitization</li>
<li><strong>Secrets</strong> — env variables, never in code</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="slide-footer"><div class="page-num">16 / 21</div></div>

## ACLEDA Competition Requirements

| Requirement | Vithey App |
|-------------|------------|
| Youth-focused mobile app | Student super app for AUB |
| Minimum 5 features | Feed, jobs, finance, chat, AI (+ profile, notifications) |
| Register / Login | Auth service + Flutter auth screens |
| Settings menu | Settings screen with preferences |
| Light + Dark mode | Theme system in Flutter |
| Flutter + GetX | Cross-platform mobile frontend |
| Spring Boot 3+ / Java 21 | 10 microservices on Java 21 |
